comparisons.peer_summary: AMD sells products via direct sales force and independent distributors/representatives, using forecasts that do not typically require minimum purchase commitments, with agreements evidenced by quotes, POs, and standard terms covering payment, warranties, and indemnities.
comparisons.comparison: AVGO describes a specific software product (SaaS Payment Security) targeting banks and merchants for fraud protection, focusing on the service's utility and customer experience. In contrast, AMD details its hardware sales distribution mechanics, explaining how it sells via direct sales and distributors based on forecasts without minimum commitments. While both disclosures address business model elements (product/service vs. sales channel), AVGO focuses on a specific SaaS value proposition for security, whereas AMD focuses on the operational structure of hardware sales arrangements.

sentences.text: Our payment security suite is a software as a service ("SaaS")-based payment authentication service to help banks and merchants protect against fraud and ensure a hassle-free online shopping experience for their customers.

Our sales arrangements generally operate on the basis of product forecasts provided by the particular customer, but do not typically include any commitment or requirement for minimum product purchases.

comparisons.peer_topic: AIB and SI Sales Model and Dynamics
comparisons.peer_summary: AMD sells component-level products to Add-in-Board (AIB) manufacturers who build board-level products for system integrators (SIs), retailers, and sub-distributors, while also selling directly to some SIs. AIB agreements typically protect inventory against price reductions, and SIs typically differentiate products using discrete graphics solutions, operating on short design cycles.
comparisons.comparison: AVGO's target disclosure focuses on a SaaS-based payment authentication service for fraud protection. AMD's peer disclosure describes a component-level supply chain model where it sells to AIB manufacturers who build board-level products for system integrators. Both are related to the technology industry's business model and sales ecosystem, but AVGO's is a direct-to-customer (via SaaS) service model for financial security, while AMD's is a B2B hardware component distribution model with inventory protections.

sentences.text: We offer component-level graphics and chipset products to AIB manufacturers who in turn build and sell board-level products using our technology to system integrators (SIs), retailers and sub distributors.
